cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Could you leave quiz night for your sister's first exhibition opening?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm captain. They'll think I've abandoned them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Tell them your sister needs you. I'd like that to outrank geography.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave after round one and say I've got a headache.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come after round one, but tell them it's for me. I want to rank above geography, not below a headache.
